content.text: I want to run this by you... from when I saw you in the cafeteria in Minnesota ..
“Whether Ausmus will be back in 2017 is a question that has yet to be answered by gener██ manager ██ Avila, who said last week in Minnesota that Ausmus has done a good job this season.”
Is that OK? I am writing a column for Sunday’s paper, saying you should bring him back
You can say we should bring him back, however, I am not ready to make any comments as I have more work to do in that area. I will wait until our season is over.
I know... I just want to make sure that’s OK, me putting in there that you said he’s done a good job this year
